learning.why: The teacher just used the cinema seat example to show that order matters, and I saw that swapping the steps gives the wrong movement for Riya's error.

end.summary:
Harsh practised identifying quadrants from coordinate signs.
They practised plotting points from ordered pairs and placing points on axes.
They practised reflecting points across an axis.
Harsh correctly identified several quadrants and axis locations.
They mixed up (3, 2) and (2, 3) as the same point; this was not corrected in a later turn.
end.parentNote: Asha practised coordinate signs, ordered pairs, axes, reflection, and the origin with Harsh. Harsh used the signs to identify quadrants and correctly described that reflection in the x-axis keeps x unchanged and changes the sign of y. They mixed up the order of coordinates in (3, 2) and (2, 3), and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, ask Harsh to plot both points on squared paper and label the horizontal coordinate first and the vertical coordinate second.
